limitations: All source queries and metric retrievals took place on 2026-10-02; the exact underlying measurement window/refresh date is not returned.
Provider estimates are not exact search counts, visits, unique people, leads, or searches specifically from C-level executives.
Closely related keywords may overlap. Their volumes must not be added into unique market size.
No data is unknown, not proof of zero demand.
Autocomplete order and occurrence frequency are not keyword popularity metrics; gl is a locale hint only.
RankSpot competition/CPC describe advertising; organic keyword difficulty was not measured.
History values have no month labels. The reported trend is retained raw but not described as YoY or used for prioritization.
A single working free metric provider is the main dataset. Third-party snapshots can disagree; do not average different methods and windows.
Search-result review supplies intent clues and publisher vocabulary, not a localized, exhaustive Google rank audit.
